title: Sharing WPA3 wifi using QR codes from one KDE machine to another does not work
line: A Wi-Fi QR code shared from a WPA3-only network now lets another Plasma machine that scans it connect, instead of failing with a PSK error.
explanation: Since the fix for bug 514026, the Networks widget writes T:WPA for WPA3 (SAE) networks, as the WPA3 spec asks, but it leaves out the spec's R:1 field that says the network accepts only SAE. On the receiving machine, Qrca builds the connection with NetworkManagerQt's fromMeCard(), which maps T:WPA to WPA-PSK and ignores R, so NetworkManager refuses the SAE-only access point. plasma-nm now adds R:1 for SAE connections, and fromMeCard() uses SAE when T:WPA comes with bit 0 of R set (T:SAE, as Android writes, already worked).

commits.message:
libs/handler: mark WPA3-only networks in Wi-Fi QR codes

QR codes for SAE networks use T:WPA as the WPA3 spec asks, but left out
its R:1 transition disable field, so scanners set up a WPA2-PSK
connection that an SAE-only access point refuses. Add R:1 for SAE.

BUG: 526296

ConnectionSettings: use SAE for WPA3-only Wi-Fi codes

WPA3 Wi-Fi codes use T:WPA and mark SAE-only networks with bit 0 of the
hex R (transition disable) field. fromMeCard ignored it and set up
WPA-PSK, which such networks refuse, so use SAE when that bit is set.

BUG: 526296

patches.diff:
From 971e64ffe4d1cced0879effe221e8108384b55c5 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 00:58:47 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] libs/handler: mark WPA3-only networks in Wi-Fi QR codes

QR codes for SAE networks use T:WPA as the WPA3 spec asks, but left out
its R:1 transition disable field, so scanners set up a WPA2-PSK
connection that an SAE-only access point refuses. Add R:1 for SAE.

BUG: 526296
---
 libs/handler.cpp | 5 ++++-
 1 file changed, 4 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/libs/handler.cpp b/libs/handler.cpp
index 1a8d79746..db930baec 100644
--- a/libs/handler.cpp
+++ b/libs/handler.cpp
@@ -241,9 +241,12 @@ void Handler::requestWifiCode(const QString &connectionPath, const QString &ssid
             break;
         case NetworkManager::WpaPsk:
         case NetworkManager::Wpa2Psk:
-        case NetworkManager::SAE:
             ret += QStringLiteral("T:WPA;");
             break;
+        case NetworkManager::SAE:
+            // R:1 (transition disable) tells the receiver to use WPA3-SAE rather than WPA2-PSK
+            ret += QStringLiteral("T:WPA;R:1;");
+            break;
         default:
         case NetworkManager::DynamicWep:
         case NetworkManager::WpaEap:
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Share on a WPA3-SAE-only network: the code has no R:1, the receiving side sets up wpa-psk and NetworkManager refuses it
Same steps with the fix: the code has R:1, the receiving side sets up sae and NetworkManager accepts it

review.text: Fixes both ends of the real cause: plasma-nm now writes the WPA3 spec's R:1 for SAE, and NetworkManagerQt's fromMeCard() honours bit 0 of R to pick SAE, with T:WPA without R, R:0 and T:SAE unchanged. Small, spec-based, and the before/after QR decode plus key-mgmt check show it. The else-if branch that re-tests "WPA" is a little indirect but correct.
